title: The Gap Map
author: Compiled from the JobOps application corpus, August 2026
description: The short book you read first. Forty-plus applications went out of JobOps between June and August 2026, and the AI-shaped ones asked for the same eight things over and over. This book counts them, sets them against what Harsh has actually shipped, writes the honest-gap answer for each one so it is said the same way every time, orders the rest of the shelf by how often an interviewer will reach for it, and ends with the question bank the other seven books are the answers to.
